name: SearchSettings
documentation:
Per-node search configuration, independent of activation through {@link Model#searchable()}.
 A node included by a searchable ancestor uses its own collection and timestamp settings.

methods.name: collection
methods.documentation: Canonical node collection. Blank retains the stable internal collection derived from the logical Model name.

methods.name: endPath
methods.documentation: Optional property path used as the document's end timestamp.

methods.name: includeDescendants
methods.documentation:
Whether a searchable scope started at this Model includes composed descendants.

Defaults to {@code true}. Setting this to {@code false} limits this Model's own root scope to itself; it does not veto inclusion of this Model in a broader searchable ancestor scope. Descendant traversal still follows only composed parent relationships, and {@link Parent#propagateSearch()} may block propagation across individual edges.

methods.name: timestampPath
methods.documentation: Optional property path used as the document's start timestamp.
